title: The quarterly audit
description: Head Office Audit opens and reseals both combination envelopes.

title: A weekend service call is booked
description: Someone telephones Fortress Alarms asking for a full sensor test over the holiday.

title: The branch closes for Easter
description: The manager locks up for the long weekend.

title: The alarm engineer's test
description: The alarm goes into test mode while the engineer checks every sensor, vault included.

title: A car leaves Millbrook
description: Someone goes out for the evening.

title: Southbound through the Millbrook toll
description: A Rover passes the toll plaza, heading for Ridgeway.

title: The vault sensor is bypassed
description: An override code is entered at the rear keypad.

title: A ticket on Harbour Street
description: The locksmith's van is ticketed outside his shop.

title: The time lock opens
description: The time lock is overridden by the service procedure.

title: The cleaner comes in
description: An extra clean on Easter Sunday morning. The vault corridor is already wet.

title: The manager comes in
description: Six minutes, escorted by the guard.

title: The empty vault is found
description: The branch reopens. The manager opens the vault.
